D: A desk-bound CIA analyst goes undercover across Europe to stop an arms deal.
P: Serve the snacks when Susan goes into the field.
S: Ham and gruyère toasties with béchamel, grilled until bubbling. Make a béchamel from 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml milk.
the Budapest leg of the mission
Fried flatbread with garlic, sour cream and cheese, Hungarian street food. Divide 500g pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin.
M: Spaghetti in a glossy pecorino and black pepper sauce. Cook 400g spaghetti. Toast 2 tsp cracked pepper, add a ladle of pasta water and the pasta, then toss with 120g grated pecorino until glossy.
W: A chocolate sheet cake for the office, cut into squares. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g melted butter.
K: Aperitivo spritz with orange, or orange soda for the kids.

s.how: Make a béchamel from 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml milk. Fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and gruyère, top with béchamel and more cheese and grill.

s.note: the Budapest leg of the mission
s.how: Divide 500g pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin. Fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Brush with garlic oil and top with 150g sour cream and 100g grated cheese.

m.how: Cook 400g spaghetti. Toast 2 tsp cracked pepper, add a ladle of pasta water and the pasta, then toss with 120g grated pecorino until glossy.

w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g melted butter. Bake in a tray at 175C for 35 minutes and ice with chocolate icing.

d.how: Fill 4 wine glasses with ice, add 60ml aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda and an orange slice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
